A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''Jedi Knight''' served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Galactic War]]. In [[3653 BBY]], a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Imperial]] force led by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] launched an [[Sacking of Coruscant|attack]] on the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]], Malgus [[Death/Legends|killed]] the female [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]].

==Biography==
[[File:DarthMalgusHS-TOR.jpg|thumb|right|145px|Sith Lord Darth Malgus, who killed the female Jedi]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and, by [[3653 BBY]], had become a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. During the [[Alderaan peace conference]] of that [[Standard year/Legends|year]]&mdash;when the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] feigned a ceasefire to negotiate with the Republic&mdash;a secret [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] strike team led by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] launched an [[Sacking of Coruscant|assault]] on the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Deceived" />

The female Jedi Knight was in the Temple at the time, and she and the other Jedi there fought against the Sith in the [[Great Hall (Jedi Temple)/Legends|Great Hall]]. During the [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]], Malgus saw the female Jedi among the crowd and shot [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] at her. The lightning caught two [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] on its path to the female before it reached her, and the force of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Force power/Legends|power]] lifted her off the ground. The Jedi Knight screamed in pain as the lightning surged through her, causing her skin to briefly become transparent, and Malgus relished in her agony as she [[Death/Legends|died]].<ref name="Deceived" />

==Powers and abilities==
A [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitive, the Human female was trained as a Jedi and achieved the rank of Jedi Knight. However, during the attack on the Temple, she was unable to stop Malgus's Force lightning, and the dark side power killed her.<ref name="Deceived" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Human female Jedi Knight appeared briefly in [[Paul S. Kemp]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''. The novel, released in [[2011]], is a tie-in to the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]].<ref name="Deceived" />
